scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF comparison around multiline attributes, embedded MTEXT group-101 scoping, column fields, and related peer failure boundaries; refine the existing 7E implementation plan only.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local source/test/plan audit
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-19, 7E, prior peer-failure mappings, and existing implementation counts
src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Attrib::parseCode, DRW_MText::parseCode, R2018 MTEXT model members and DWG codec fields
src/libdxfrw.cpp: dxfRW::writeEmbeddedMText and MTEXT background serialization
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: testZeroYHatch and generated embedded ATTRIB/ATTDEF ASCII/binary controls
method.limitations: LibreDWG #1410 and ACadSharp #1279 are reporter-authored peer reports, not independent reproductions. Autodesk documentation is authoritative for documented DXF field descriptions but does not settle every version-specific emitted ordering or local compatibility policy. The local audit did not run test binaries or native CAD; its findings describe source/test coverage, not a runtime regression reproduction. The follow-up receipt corrects the group-101 host-specific grammar and replaces this receipt's earlier repeated-group-50 column-height test instruction with the scoped group-46 R2018 mapping.

evidence.observed: The open report separates explicit-zero HATCH coordinate rejection, unusual ATTDEF/ATTRIB tag loss, and incomplete handling of multiline embedded-MTEXT fields. It explicitly cautions that a flat whitelist is a stopgap and that group-101 scope must be honored.
doesNotEstablish: general validity of every unusual attribute tag in every target consumer
semantic support for every code in the reported 42-49 range
native AutoCAD acceptance verified in this research pass
evidence.planUse: Reuse local zero-Y and basic embedded-attribute controls; extend existing 7E with bounded standalone, ATTRIB, and ATTDEF group-101 grammar tests.

evidence.topic: Autodesk MTEXT and ATTRIB field contract
evidence.observed: The references document nested MTEXT for multiline attributes, the R2018 defined-height and background properties, and MTEXT column groups 48, 49, 50, 75, 76, 78, and 79. They label 42/43 read-only and ignored when supplied; the consulted MTEXT table does not assign a meaning to group 47.
doesNotEstablish: whether every producer emits all documented fields in the same order
whether libdxfrw should preserve or discard read-only 42/43 values
semantics for undocumented group 47 in embedded attributes
evidence.planUse: This initial pass proposed a field/direction/version matrix; its broad group-50 column note is superseded by the follow-up scope reconciliation, which separates direct R2018 group-46 heights from ordinary group-50 rotation and encoded XDATA sub-key 50.

evidence.observed: Source routes the group-101 attribute payload into a separate DRW_MText and the writer emits core embedded text/background fields. Existing model and DWG codec have column state, but DXF parse/write lacks the full column profile. Existing generated tests cover HATCH explicit-zero, marker spelling, basic embedded text, tags/prompts, orientation, and sentinels, not complete embedded column values.
doesNotEstablish: a reproduced failure or runtime behavior from this read-only audit
a need for a new test target or committed drawing fixture
evidence.planUse: Refine only PAR-19/7E and extend the current generated test owner in ASCII and binary.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG #1351 is a peer INSERT sequence report whose author later verified the peer's master output contained ATTRIB and SEQEND; no matching local writer path was identified. LibreDWG #1361/#1363 trace a peer LWPOLYLINE symptom to R2007 data-page decoding. ACadSharp #1279 remains a version-specific subclass-marker report already mapped to PAR-14/7BS.
doesNotEstablish: a reason to bypass page-decoder diagnosis
evidence.planUse: Keep sequence grammar, AC1021/R2007 page decoding, and legacy subclass tolerance in their existing owners.

readinessRefinement: Exercise standalone MTEXT's R2018 column object separately from the ordinary embedded-MTEXT body used by ATTRIB and ATTDEF.
Assert that group-50 rotation and scope-specific group-46 values do not overwrite one another, and preserve outer tag/prompt/sequence framing.
Implement documented column fields with count/value bounds; resolve the local read-only 42/43 retention/re-emission behavior before treating it as writable parity.
Do not infer group-47 semantics from a peer whitelist; keep unusual-tag policy consumer/spec gated.
Reuse existing zero-Y HATCH, attribute, sequence, and page-decoder test owners; add no committed fixtures or per-slice full-suite work.
